assumptions.description: Current SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA files are provisional rough constraints from the repository; they support generation and review intake only, not official redline, planning approval, parcel claims, or precise area scoring.
assumptions.required_follow_up: Replace with official or cleared polygons when provided, then rerun geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, visual, finalize and self-check.

assumptions.description: Proofyard buildings, public yards, green corridors, roads and phases are conceptual urban-design reference geometries. They express program relationships and auditability, not statutory land-use approvals or engineering alignments.
assumptions.required_follow_up: Professional planning, traffic, municipal, ownership, accessibility, heritage and public-safety teams must deepen before implementation.

assumptions.description: FAR, height, density, setback, road redline, municipal capacity, ownership and detailed architectural conditions are not in the public site package.
assumptions.required_follow_up: Obtain official regulatory-planning and design-brief attachments.

assumptions.description: AI scenario cards assume data minimization, explicit authorization, local aggregation where possible, public-interest purpose limitation, manual override, and non-digital service alternatives.
assumptions.required_follow_up: Draft detailed data processing agreements and review with legal, community and professional operators before any pilot.
